notes: UNVALIDATED, and deliberately DIFFERENT from bootstrap-unvalidated-v2 in model type, signal set, rule order and usable bound. Exists for exactly one purpose: contracts/agreement.md's two-calibrations case (FR-019) -- proving both languages actually read the configuration, because two implementations that both ignored the file would agree with each other under every single-config case. The logistic coefficients are PLACEHOLDERS chosen to be visibly unfitted (round numbers); the intercept and signs merely make the score move in the plausible direction (more relative support = higher score, more flow = lower). Nothing here is a finding. The score is squashed algebraically, not by the logistic sigmoid -- see contracts/calibration-config.md on transcendental-free scoring.
